title: Rules from last week's corrections — Mon Nov 2, 2026

items.text: Site Rebuild keeps the customer's own look
items.summary: You corrected this five times on 10/27, once marked LOCKED. The rebuilds kept drifting into the Field Manual / AI-template look. Rule: when we scrape a site, save its colors, logos, fonts and real photos to an asset sheet, and the rebuild uses them heavily. Improve layout, speed and SEO, but it must still look like that business. Strip AI tells before publish (emoji feature grids, purple glows, grain overlays, generic 'Local Service' chrome). Goes in Site Rebuild's job card and its playbook.

Six fixes on 10/27 to the before/after page. Rule: headline says 'Needed for 2027.' (never a past year); the comparison sits in one wide box that fits a screen; full-page screenshots scroll inside it (no live iframes); the drag handle is big, high-contrast and labeled; no decorative badge up top; the real logo shows at readable size with no duplicate text wordmark. Goes in Site Rebuild's template notes.

items.text: Site Rebuild offer: under $1,000, links not zips, track spend
items.summary: On 10/26 the bot put $1,997 pricing in the pitch that you never set, tried to attach a zip (Gmail blocked it), and had no spend tracking. Rule: offer stays under $1,000 until you name the exact number; outreach links to the hosted pack and never attaches a zip; every rebuild keeps its own API/token spend file from start to finish.

items.text: Site Rebuild models: Grok 4.7 builds, Cursor designs
items.summary: On 10/26 the bot flip-flopped three times and asked you for an Anthropic API key. You said Grok 4.7 for the build pipeline, Cursor (Claude on your Ultra plan) only for design polish, never the Claude API. Rule goes in Site Rebuild's card and points at coding-spend.md.

items.text: Logins: Vault first, never show a login form it already has
items.summary: Repeat. On 10/26 you got a Google sign-in form for rosey@ even though the Vault already had that login, and asked if I was being lazy. Same lesson as last week's card 3, which is still waiting. Rule for every bot: list the Vault before any login ask; if the login is there, fill from it and never show the form; an old env-var password isn't a reason to ask you.

items.text: Usage burn: heavy push on day 5, stop when you say stop
items.summary: On 10/26 you said I burned too early (65% gone by day 3), and on 10/27 you said don't burn, you needed the quota. Rule: days 1 to 4 are real work only; the burn push starts on day 5 and aims near 100% by reset; the moment you say you need the quota, stop all burn starts and pause the routine until you say go. The burn routine is paused now.

items.text: Website and PrintFlow deploys after hours only
items.summary: On 10/26 a mid-morning merge and repeated Railway redeploys bugged the crew. Rule: merges and deploys for printhybrid.com and PrintFlow go out after hours (about 10 PM CT) unless you or Rosey call it urgent. Goes in both coders' cards.

items.text: Read the whole message thread before calling it a lead
items.summary: On 10/26 Marketing pitched a quote to Noah Bennet on Facebook when the thread was a digitizer selling to us. Rule: open the full thread first; anything that's a vendor pitch (digitizing, 'hire us') gets a short polite no drafted for your OK, never quote-ask copy. Goes in Marketing's card.

items.text: Choice buttons go on the page you're looking at
items.summary: On 10/26 the Fleet Command Center page showed the Needs-you list with no way to act, and the Progress/Hold/Close choices were on a separate checklist. Rule: any triage page puts the choice controls right on its rows; a separate checklist is backup only. Fleet rule.

items.text: X's scheduled briefs always reach you and cover more of AI
items.summary: On 10/28 you noticed the morning X brief went silent. Rule: every scheduled X brief sends at least a one-line note, and it covers Grok Bot plus Anthropic/Claude, OpenAI, Grok/xAI and big product launches. X already changed its prompts; this makes it standing.

items.text: Print Hybrid branding uses the jackalope logo, done right
items.summary: Three corrections on 10/29 (X and Art). Rule: all Print Hybrid branding uses the jackalope logo; files are transparent (no pink background); on dark backgrounds the black parts turn white; and the bot confirms the exact logo file with you before making brand cards. Fleet rule for Art, Marketing, X and the website.

items.text: Last week's 12 rules are still waiting
items.summary: The 10/26 list (send from Rosey only, check shopping links, Vault and Save, Professor lesson standards, Dad Life do-it-yourself, Printavo to PrintFlow and six more) never got a Submit, so none of it has been applied. It's here: https://seankirk77.github.io/ck-eda0a596/4eb274e7a6bbfca2e85c90e7/?list=corrections-2026-10-26
items.rec: Open and submit that list. Mark this Drop if you'd rather let those go.

items.text: This week's one change: a stuck ping expires after 3 business days
items.summary: The robot-ranking ping has been the Open ping since 10/7, so about 30 finished results have been held quiet behind it. Proposal: if you haven't answered the Open ping in 3 business days, it moves to the top of Waiting and the next most important item gets to reach you. The other option is to keep the hard block but resurface the stuck ping once a week.
